title: Strixhaven Mystical Archive: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: "This must not become common knowledge. The consequences of such a spell are too great. Lock it away in the restricted archive, and destroy its record in the catalog." —Director Taiva, to Isabough
"For twelve days and twelve nights, Somat assailed the monster's shell. On the thirteenth morning, it cracked with the dawn." —*Heroics: A Book of Fables*
"Evil is to be unshackled, not slain. Unlock your foe and release the miracle within." —Keevan, docent of Kollema Hall
"We asked for a home and received the world." —*Scroll of Nine Blessings*
"The tyrant's bellow of rage trailed off into a whimper as the last of his fortune escaped his grasp." —*The Dethroner's Grimoire*
"Knight Kathryn closed her eyes, bracing herself for the end. When she opened them again, she stood triumphant over her foe." —Thadus the Healer, *Memoirs*
"The blademaster turned his fury to his new foes: root rot and cabbage slugs." —*Myths and Miracles, Vol. VII*
"Five suns! Can you even imagine how complicated the orbital calculations must be? What I wouldn't give to tackle an equation like that!" —Zimone, Quandrix mage-student
"Infinite ideas flow through the Multiverse, waiting for an open mind." —*The Biblioplex: An Introduction*
"Every Planeswalker remembers the first time their mind touched the staggering vastness of the Multiverse." —Kasmina
"One need not know the specific details of a spell to suppress its effect. Simply rearrange the rules of the reality within which the spell operates." —Imbraham, Quandrix dean
"Where do our forgotten thoughts go? I knew once, but I can't remember." —Director Taiva, journal entry
"Shatter your opponent's spell with enough force, and you'll shatter their confidence with it." —*Tome of Obstructions*, marginalia
"The wish most often granted is the wish to choose one's own destiny." —*Aethershrine*, inscription
"I can offer only information, young one. What path you choose is up to you." —Jadzi, Oracle of Arcavios
"Chronomancers have a rather different definition of living in the moment." —*The Millennium Tome*
"If they try to storm your palace, you must become the storm." —*Handbook of Imperial Spellcraft*
"Guilt is not absolution. Regret is not justice. But it is right that you suffer." —Extus Narr
"One brother fought for the sake of the Multiverse. The other for himself." —*The Elderspell Parable*
"They distrust my methods, but when they want results, whom do you think they seek?" —*Incantations of Lim-Dûl*
"Demons prefer to deal with those who believe themselves too wise to be fooled." —Scroll case inscription
"An angel can shine like the sun, inspire the weak, and even threaten victory over darkness. But in the end it matters not, for it still dies like any other pest." —Ob Nixilis
"Magic brought peace to the Vastlands but was soon corrupted." —*The Mystic Age: A Saga of Spells*
"It takes so little energy to erase a person. It's almost like the universe doesn't care that they existed at all." —Extus Narr
"To dwell within the Blind Eternities is unthinkable. To encounter those who do could shatter the mind." —*Chronicle of the Titans*
"It's always my brightest students who make the worst decisions." —Shaile, Silverquill dean
"My colleagues revile the barbarity of the Blood Age, but I believe we have much to learn from the magics of endless war." —Embrose, Silverquill dean
"Be careful when handling old magical trinkets. You never know who they've been." —Augusta, Lorehold dean
"Will! They have a copy of *Tales of the Fae* here! Want me to read you a bedtime story?" —Rowan Kenrith
"How did you get your hands on that? Wait, never mind. I don't want to know." —Plargg, Lorehold dean
"Some mages duel using intricate spellcraft and superior tactics. Others just get really, really mad." —*Secrets of the Feradorn Sorcerers*
"The first mages witnessed the fury of the raging storm and wished to answer back." —*The Stormwright Texts*
"To this day, I have no idea if the heavens were obeying him or attacking him." —Ral Zarek, research notes
"Thus, Bruk the Skyhammer earned his epithet and won the war, all in one fiery moment." —*Compendium of Warspells*
"If the prospect of what could be doesn't electrify you to your core, why attend Strixhaven at all?" —Nassari, Prismari dean
"Her quest began as all quests do, with one small step in an unexpected direction." —*The Explorer's Testament*
"As long as you are breathing, you always have something more to give." —Valentin, Witherbloom dean
"You'd be amazed how much a single plant has to teach you." —Lisette, Witherbloom dean
"The bloody din of invasion faded And silent song rang through the woods again." —"Song of Freyalise"
"On a world where time was torn asunder, destruction ruled the minds of all." —*Multiversal Metahistories*
"Nature is neither cruel nor kind. It operates on necessity, not sentiment." —Dina, Witherbloom mage-student
"Centuries of war had broken Arcavios, but a single seed began the long process of renewal." —*The Mystic Age: A Saga of Spells*
"Never reject the kindness of a serpent. It will not be offered twice." —Druidic manuscript fragment
"Neither blade nor tempest can assail the serenity of a tranquil mind." —*The Turrau Carvings*
"A tale of a tyrant being humiliated and losing all his power? I'm inspired already!" —Killian, Silverquill mage-student
"The hydraulic power grip was a failure, but the gauntlets were a shocking success." —Journal of the Prime Izmagnus
"I've gleaned greater insight from the spiraling of a single fern than I have from all the books I've ever read." —Kianne, Quandrix dean
"Mages in the Blood Age would call down actual thunderstorms on their enemies. I bet we can replicate their technique." —Dradiel, Lorehold mage-student
"From monarch to mulch as quick as could be." —*The Dethroner's Grimoire*
